snippet.title: Pokémon Pokopia - Pokémon Day 2.27.2026 | Special Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as a Ditto and Build a New Life with Pokémon—from the Ground Up! Befriend Pokémon like DJ Rotom and  Chef Dente as you build your world. Pokémon Pokopia Releasing on Nintendo Switch 2 on March 5, 2026.
